article.story: HEMPSTEAD, N.Y. -- — Trey Boyd III’s 18 points helped Hofstra defeat Saint Joseph’s (L.I.) 97-51 on Monday. Boyd shot 7 for 14, including 4 for 8 from beyond the arc for the Pride (1-0). Joshua DeCady scored 12 points while going 4 of 8 and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line, and added eight rebounds. Nick Jefferson shot 4 for 12 (1 for 4 from 3-point range) and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points. Moose McLaurin led the Golden Eagles in scoring, finishing with 11 points. Kenny Rodriguez added eight points for Saint Joseph’s (L.I.). Amir Reushell-Sanders finished with eight points. Hofstra took the lead with 17:40 left in the first half and did not trail again. Boyd led their team in scoring with 15 points in the first half to help put them up 40-23 at the break. Hofstra pulled away with a 15-3 run in the second half to extend a 22-point lead to 34 points. They outscored Saint Joseph’s (L.I.) by 29 points in the final half, as Jefferson led the way with a team-high nine second-half points. Up next Hofstra visits Princeton in its next matchup on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
